quote: With the firm purpose of contributing to the energy development of the country and the region, AES El Salvador inaugurated the Nejapa plant, the first in Central America capable of generating energy from methane gas captured from a landfill. … AES El Salvador currently has 16 generation plants: one based on biogas and 15 solar plants.
note: Opened AES El Salvador English 13 Aug 2025; companion Nejapa Plant page for 6 MW capacity.
